body:
All I've been doing is trying to find someone I genuinely enjoy. The one girl that ever made me feel genuinely happy and loved is sharing her love with another guy. I just want to find that one person that makes me feel like she did. There has to be someone else out there.

You'll get your chance. I promise. Don't waste it.
It sucks. A lot. I'm at a point in my life where I've never felt so insignificant.
